div.head: I Cn 17
div.ab: We forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ lenctendagum [⁊ rihtfæstendagum] ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð(ðe) se eahteoða dæg agán sy ofer Twelftadæg ⁊ fram Septuagessima oþ(þe) fiftyne niht ofer Eastron.

And we forbid ordeals and oaths during festivals and the Ember Days and days in Lent, and on legally appointed fast days, and from the Advent till the eighth day after Twelfth Night, and from the Septuagesima till fifteen days after Easter.

And we forbeodað ordal ⁊ aðas freolsdagum ⁊ ymbrendagum ⁊ lengctendagum ⁊ rihtfæstendagum ⁊ fram Aduentum Domini oð se eahtaþa dæg agán sig ofer Twelftan mæssdæge ⁊ fram Septuagessima oð XV nihton ofer Eastron.
